Title: RSI Disc. Month: Constellation Rental Offer
Description:
Calling all RSI Enthusiasts!

A core value of Robert Space Industries is exploration and adventure - and in keeping with that - we are thrilled to provide all pilots with the chance to test fly the new <EM4>RSI Constellation Mk V</EM4>!

All you have to do is collect the Golden Constellation box from the plinth at one of our special event locations and deliver it to another <EM4>RSI Event Platform</EM4>. Once you've done that, you'll be able to enjoy the test flight period. It’s as simple as that!

The Constellation Mk V is one of RSI's most versatile ships to date. Featuring four S5 weapons, two remote turrets, and 240 SCU of cargo storage, this ship caters for all kinds of adventures.

We hope you enjoy this opportunity to experience the future of spaceflight first hand and that it will be just the first of many more adventures to come.

Enjoy your journey,

Christoph Roester
RSI Community Outreach Manager
